title: Broke with light use
text: Broke with light use. I bought these chairs in April 2020. Easy to assemble and very pretty. However, one of the legs broke in August 2020 after light use by one person (my husband) who weighs well beneath the weight limit specified for the chairs. He was able to rig the broken leg for a couple months but it just broke again. I contacted the company who told me the chair is out of warranty, and further, they do not have replacement legs in stock even for purchase. There is no reason at all this chair should have broken the way it did, but after reading several other reviewers' issues, I realize this is not an isolated problem. Would not recommend these to anyone unless you don't plan to sit on them.
